name: weildbuild-server
description: WeildBuild platform servers: Main Server (REST API + orchestration), Realtime (presence/chat), Game Host (game instances). Deploys to Render, database on Neon. v1.11.0: the Votes page (players post ideas + upvote; admins set statuses Approved/Considering/Not Approved/Already Planned, close dates end voting, client adds Search), automatic pink Welcome Letters on signup (accounts now start with 20 WeBuy), announcement kinds (WeildBuild Update / Announcement / Admin Message / Message / custom) carried on notifications + realtime pushes. v1.9.0: admin role commands, announcements (letters with instant Realtime push), Notification.title + User.notifyToasts. v1.8.1: any https://*.vercel.app origin allowed.
//: BUILD FIX v1.2.0: prisma, typescript, tsx and @types/* live in dependencies ON PURPOSE. Render builds run with NODE_ENV=production, and npm silently skips devDependencies in that mode — that is what broke the v1.1 deploy (TS7016: no declaration file for 'express'). Do NOT move them back to devDependencies.

scripts.setup: npm run migrate && npm run seed
